The '''father''' of [[Corso Riggs]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was the father of [[Corso Riggs]], whom he taught about responsibility with weapons. During the [[Separatist War]] on Ord Mantell he and his wife were killed by the Separatist forces.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Corso Riggs's father is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Corso Riggs companion mission.
